notes: Messages from SSM-Audio. From time to time the plugin shows a short message in a window (news, an important update). Each message is shown once. To ask for it, the plugin sends only the product, its version, the language of your system and whether you are in the trial or licensed; nothing that names you. See the [privacy policy](https://ssm-audio.github.io/Best-Trigger-3/privacy.html).
